{{Top|leg}}
'''Missile buoys''' were [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-designed [[Satellite/Legends|satellites]]. Controlled from a central [[Starship/Legends|ship]] such as an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]], the missile buoys were deployed in a [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]]. Imperial forces were able to use the buoys to target enemy ships and fire multiple [[Missile/Legends|missiles]] at them.
